Job_Title: Chemical laboratory technician - focus on wet chemistry, moisture
Employer_Category: Manufacture of basic pharmaceutical products and pharmaceutical preparations
Description: Here are the details of the job You come to us in a team of ten people. Together with your colleagues, you will analyze the raw materials that we will later process into tablets or capsules, testing mainly active substances and excipients such as lactose or cellulose. A wide range of analyses awaits you: from GC to HPLC, from IC to titration, particle size determinations with different methods, all wet chemical - and once and twice a month an ICP with mass spectroscopy is available. Exciting? We think so, too. No day is like the other. But your flexibility is also required: You were just in a GC analysis, then a rushing infrared measurement comes in between... no problem for you? Then you fit perfectly with us. By the way, everything you do must also be documented; check the work steps, describe some more detailed processes, this is always part of the GMP's just work. Another task: device administration. Everyone in the team is responsible for one or more analyzers and methods - also for their qualification: Before we can use a device/method for routine work, it must be ensured that we can rely on the results. To do this, you communicate with customers and manufacturers, drive many samples... This can do you a month and occurs two or three times a year. Would be great if you knew about it. If not, we will teach you step by step.
Requirements: So you are knitted You should be a chemical laboratory and have a few years of professional experience; either in the pharmaceutical industry (which would be perfect) or in the food or cosmetics industry. In addition, you should be a little IT-affinist: database knowledge would be good and you would have to get involved in the software of the analyzers. We will also help you with this, of course. It is also important that you work very precisely and precisely. With the strict quality requirements for our products, there is simply no room for inaccuracies. And we need your research spirit. If there is no one to ask or no one knows the answer, you know how to help yourself: you consult manuals or talk for example to the manufacturer... - So independent work is required.

You have 30 days of vacation and if you want to take a day off spontaneously, you can do it. Job_Title: Commercial Brand Manager, Frankfurt am Main
Description:
• You actively control the commercial development of your area of responsibility and continuously work to optimize sales and earnings.
• On the basis of key figures, you analyze performance, identify potentials and derive concrete measures from them - from product range adjustments to pricing to promotions and presentation at the point of sale.
• A special focus is on working with Pret A Manger's franchiser. You ensure that brand standards are met and at the same time continue to develop the concept within the local requirements of an international airport location.
• In close exchange with our operational teams - especially on site in Zurich - you accompany the implementation of measures directly in the outlets.
• You understand the requirements in day-to-day business and ensure that concepts are not only strategically meaningful, but also practical.
• In addition, you are involved in cross-cutting projects such as product launches, marketing measures or the further development of the customer journey.
• In cooperation with interfaces such as marketing, purchasing, controlling and data, you ensure that all activities are integrated and implemented in a targeted manner.
Requirements:
• The basis for your job with us is your studies in business administration, marketing or a comparable area.
• In the last 2 to 4 years, you have already gained sound experience in brand, category or trade marketing, ideally within the (system) gastronomy or FMCG industry.
• A familiar approach to the Swiss market, whether through training or professional experience, is a welcome plus.
• You have safe handling of key figures and strong analytical skills.
• You also have very good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
• Thanks to your communication strength, you always act confidently towards internal and external partners.
• For the close exchange with our Swiss colleagues, you are regularly present at the Zurich site.
• Negotiable German and English round off your profile.
Benefits:
• A dynamic working environment awaits you in an internationally active company in the catering industry.
• Up to 50% discount in all our sales outlets throughout Germany.
• Our support center at Frankfurt Airport is easily accessible by public transport.
• We offer you the opportunity to participate in our employee share program.
• We also offer you a thorough training, flexible working hours and the possibility of mobile work.
• You profit from employee offers at over 600 well-known providers such as adidas, C&A, Vodafone, Thalia, Rossmann.
• Use the possibility to lease a bike or e-bike with tax advantages via JobRad.
• Diversity and team spirit are a top priority in our team.
• We reward your commitment with an indefinite employment contract and 30 days of vacation.

Job_Title: Cleaning power, Cologne
ISCO_4_name: Cleaners and helpers in offices, hotels and other establishments
Company_Name: Ensemble Phoenix - Bühnenspielgemeinschaft e. V. Urania im Spiegelpalast
Description: These are your tasks at the Urania Theater Spiegelpalast So that our Spiegelpalast shines in the best light before every performance, you take care of the care of our premises yourself. Your focus is on the following areas: The splendour in the auditorium: You clean the stage, suck the floors in the dining room and ensure that the seating is neat and inviting for the next guests. Hygiene in the sanitary facilities: Cleaning and disinfection of guest toilets and artist toilets as well as filling up consumables such as towels and soap are among your fixed tasks. Cleanliness in the entrance area: You keep the foyer and the wardrobe clean, so that the first impression is perfect when entering the theatre. Care of the surfaces: Since a mirror palace lives from its sparkle, you pay special attention to clean glass and mirror surfaces as well as dust-free railings and sills. Preparation for the operation: You dispose of waste and ensure that all cleaning utensils are ready for the next use.
Requirements: What you bring In addition to the artisanal handles, your attitude counts for us above all. We are looking for someone who sees this task not only as a job, but with heart and soul. Passion for details: You like to do it neatly and enjoy yourself the most when everything sparkles in the end and is ready for the show. Reliability & punctuality: You are our rock in the surf. You can count on it so that the curtain can open on time in a clean room. You bring good knowledge of German with you in order to easily coordinate in the team and to rest assured instructions. Look for the whole: You see by yourself where a helping hand or a wiper cloth is needed, because you consider the mirror palace as your own project and want it to shine in the best light. Joy at work: A smile on your face is part of it for you, even if it is sometimes treacherous. You like to work independently and carefully.
Benefits: Why you like to be part of the Urania Theater Spiegelpalast Even if you usually swirl before the first guests arrive or the curtain opens, you are an indispensable part of our success. Not only do we show you this in words: above-average pay: good work earns good money. We pay you over-tariff and fair because we know what you're doing. Planable feel-good working hours: Your assignments are concentrated on three days between Wednesday and Sunday. This means for you: steady days at a time and no stress with constantly changing shifts. A workspace with magic: Instead of in dreary offices, you work in the glittering world of the Mirror Palace. It's a place with a soul where you just like to be. Real appreciation in the background: Even if you may not see our team in full line-up every day, you are not a number with us. We'll keep your back on you, take care of top work materials and always have an open ear for you. Safe port: You get an indefinite contract in an established cultural establishment - you can rely on us.
